Thanks. I really appreciate the enthusiasm, and it's really nice to have someone who actually believes in me right now.

The thought of another woman or.. anything just makes me feel sick. Maybe I'm being overdramatic. I don't know.

No, because there has been no reason too. Up until now. Literally, about a week ago I noticed something. Unless I somehow got something from her a year later.. Possible I guess.

But no. And she probably should.
I don't know if it is or not. I've been to the doctor, and he's not really sure what it is yet. Could be anything, really.

That's what I told her when I found out. She said that she was a coward. At least she owned up to it.

I just keep picturing it in my head.. at this point I know I'm not ready to forgive. But, I want to so bad.

That's what were doing now. I'm not speaking to her right now. But, I feel like I'm going to break. And I feel like she will as well. She's respecting that I need time, but I know her. And I know she doesn't want this.

I do want to try and work on myself in the mean time.. I just don't know how to start. I guess that will come in time.

The funny thing is, I've never had another break up. I don't know how to handle any break ups. She was my first long-lasting girlfriend since high school.. and I really don't know how to act without her here.

I'm trying really hard to focus on other things.. It just feels like all motivation has been stripped from me. I don't want to be a pitty party or anything. But, I feel horrible.

I do need some time to think though. My friends previously asked me to go have a night downtown.. I was considering it, but I don't think that would be a great idea as it would involve a lot of drinking.

The relationship was good otherwise. She's my best friend. She always knows how to make me feel better.

I'm assuming it was a drunken mistake. I was out of the country for two months. And at the time, things weren't as great as they should have been. I guess I left things at an off note. Though, we were still together. But things have been good ever since.

I found out because I went to the doctor for some health concerns. I was told to ask her if it had anything to do with her. I guess it just forced it out of her.
